name: Geometric Nonrealizability Does Not Obstruct Maximum Parents
statement: Failure of affine-convex realizability does not imply failure to have a maximum parent. The 26-word corner-deletion class is nonrealizable in every affine dimension but has an explicit maximum parent of rank four on eight coordinates.
proof: Affine-convex sign classes form a sufficient geometric subclass of maximum-generated classes. The verified eight-coordinate parent has the 26-word class as its exact two-auxiliary zero section, while the independent signed-ratio cycle excludes every affine-convex realization.
